explanation: Backtrack over candidate indices in nondecreasing order. Reusing the current index permits repeated values; never moving backward prevents duplicate combinations.
timeComplexity: O(c^(d+1) + output size) upper bound for c candidates and d = target / smallest candidate.
spaceComplexity: O(d) recursion and current-path space, excluding output.
